text:
mia: Quick sync — we need one consolidated spec for canary/A-B dashboards that includes routing and quota inputs from runtime. CC @ken @aj : can we capture the routing decision labels today?

aj: +1. We currently emit routing_policy and route_reason at request completion, but labels are sparse. need to add: route_bucket, fallback_model, assigned_capacity_tier.

devon: For dashboards we also need quota context — was request throttled, quota_bucket, and effective_rate_limit. Without it, a perf regression could be misattributed to canary vs quota.

ken: Agree. question: do we send those as top-level metric labels or a separate telemetry event? top-level labels blow up cardinality.

mia: Cardinality is the main tradeoff. Proposal: keep low-cardinality labels on core counters and emit a sampling stream (1%) with full routing/debug payload for diagnostics. Dashboards use aggregated core counters; alerts can link to sampled traces.

olivia: Sounds good. For the sampled payload we need to ensure PII redaction (user_id -> hashed_user_bucket). Also add kv_cache_miss boolean and prefix_cache_hit.

mia: Draft metric name convention (for review):
```
redwood.rollout.requests.count{model_variant, rollout_id, route_bucket, outcome}  # outcome = success, fallback, throttled, error
redwood.runtime.latency.p50|p95{model_variant, rollout_id, route_bucket}
redwood.runtime.kv_cache.miss_rate{model_variant, rollout_id}
redwood.rollout.quota.throttle_count{quota_bucket, rollout_id}
```

tia: We should include a derived metric: delta_success_rate = success_rate(canary) - success_rate(control) with time-windowed smoothing (5m/1h). That helps quickly spot regressions during rollout.

ken: Implementation note: prometheus-style metrics are fine, but for per-request attributes (route_reason, assigned_capacity_tier) we should also ship a structured event to telemetry service (s3/gcs blob) for offline joins.

aj: Also add token-level cost signal: tokens_generated.sum with model_variant and rollout_id. Cost spikes are often the first signal of regressions.

devon: For the dashboard layout I propose 3 panels per rollout:
- Comparative throughput + success_rate (control vs canary)
- Latency violin + p95 trend with route_bucket breakouts
- Cost/token and KV cache miss trend
Include a small widget that shows % requests routed to canary by region and capacity tier.

mia: UX ask: the console should let PMs toggle smoothing windows and select baseline slice (all users or authenticated-only). Make slices driven by label filters.

olivia: Regarding quotas, add a visualization: throttle_rate / effective_limit by quota_bucket. If throttle_rate changes during canary, flag rollout.

ken: Few open design decisions:
1) sampling fraction for debug events (mia suggested 1%) — agree?
2) label set: route_bucket vs route_reason — both? keep route_bucket on core metrics, route_reason only in sampled events.
3) how to surface fallback model impact — provide both absolute fallback_count and fallback_ratio relative to total requests.

aj: +1 to those defaults. For sampling, 0.5% might be enough to keep cost down; start 1% and tune.

mia: Privacy check — olivia can we reuse the existing redaction lib for sampled payloads? Need an exception workflow for audits.

olivia: yes, reuse redaction_lib v2. Add matrix: allowed_fields (model_variant, rollout_id, route_bucket, kv_cache_miss, latency, token_count, fallback_model_hashed). user_id -> hashed_user_bucket only. Security signoff required for raw traces.

sre-bot: deploy (eng-runtime): telemetry-schema v3.5 -> canary-metrics-feature branch merged by ken at 1784123512

devon: thanks bot. ken, when can we expect the runtime labels to flow to metrics backend? Need ETA for dashboards.

ken: Working on it. ETA: instrumented metrics by EOD tomorrow, sampling pipeline after that (48h). Will post PR to telemetry-contract repo.

mia: Action items:
- ken: implement core labels + sampling (ETA 48h)
- aj: add tokens_generated and quota labels to metrics SDK (ETA 48h)
- olivia: confirm redaction matrix and security path (ETA 24h)
- devon: mock dashboard panels in console prototype (ETA 72h)

tia: small ask: add an automated canary check that computes rolling delta and auto-annotates dashboard when delta > threshold for 15m. We can then wire alerts.

mia: Agreed. We'll add a regression signal service that computes: delta_success_rate, delta_p95_latency, delta_cost_per_token. Thresholds per rollout can be configured in the rollout policy.

ken: I'll draft telemetry-contract PR including metric names, label sets, and sampling config. Will ping this thread when done.

aj: FYI — linking old reference: https://internal.redwood.dev/telemetry/rollout-contracts (private)

mia: Thanks everyone — this feels actionable. If anyone has objections to the cardinality approach (core labels minimal + sampling) speak now. Otherwise I'll lock the spec in the tickets. :thumbsup:

ken: No objections from infra side.

olivia: Security ok with plan pending the redaction matrix doc.

devon: Good to go from dashboard side.

sre-bot: note: ticket created INFR-3242 "canary telemetry: dashboard inputs and sampling" assigned to ken, aj, devon at 1784123575

mia: Closing loop — I'll create the RFC with the decisions and include a sample dashboard JSON and the metric name table. Thanks!
